segments.transliteration: nahiyu uwohiyunv tsadihv ... gesdi’eka ase ali,tsadohvsgi, yuli,sdodi yigi, uwohiyudi yvwi, vsgiwuniga gehv aya, hena,--aya, hena, tsigi, osdatlanvtla wi,ganvgv una--unatloyolelv gehv awu gusoi, wiganvgv ... awenvsv osda squu awadanv,dv gayula awanvsa, sdigida gosdi, “good news” datsiwa,dvhidoli, nawali,sdanehe ... awena uwasawu tsinuwesv osdatlanvtla “gago osda yidawvdawotsa?” awehelv “John gesdidv didawosdi yidvtsasdelvhi,” tsiyohelv “hohiyunv hena, nohena, tsigi, we’ll lead you into Christ,” tsiyohelv ... nigada oginilosv na gi.lo na yigohiyuhvsdi tsanvtas na sgina, uwetsi, ageya gawonisgv squu nahiyu squu “Yeah, John,” agohelv “Just—just—uh” etsuladvno woginiwonisvno ... “sgidv nigada gv.ni, gesv yinitsvnelv, hisgvnagehv noquunv na ‘tsisgvna’ yi.yohela, tsisa, galoneda, *y’know* detsadanilvga hena tla hena--tla hena nelagawu” tsiyohelv nahiyu sginana sdigida na Roman’s Road witsiyatinvstanv tsana,diho yusdi igada anali,tsadohvsgi, sgiyusdi tsinoselv tsanv,tas na doyu, uwohiyunv nahiyu ... tlasquu *week later* tsigehv tsunoyvtlitlv uyohusv tsidvyudvnv na utsi udvnv na ani--usdayvhvsgidv awalihelitsvwu uwasa, tsudanv,tetlv uwohiyu,di sdigida hena,...sdigida hena, e... nigohilv edohe gehv *church* doyiwu yedohi, gehv sdigidv na degalasohv gehv doyi ditlvwu gohusdiwu nudale yaninohe gi.lo na’e nahiyu igada na sgika tsinusdi gi.lo... gi.lo yunv,tano dvyohusisv nahiyu yigohiyuhvga sgi squu yvda, asenvka yigada tsisa, gadv nav “squanv,dada,” tsagohele “natlegv.wu wigvna,dvnesdi,” tsagosele sginana
segments.translation: “That’s when he believed,” he said. It doesn’t have to be a preacher to get somebody to believe. And I had a brother in the hospital—they had given up on him. He was over at Muskogee. I went over there, and I was feeling good. When I went, I felt like I was going to get good news. He said it himself, my brother, “Who would be good to baptize me?” he said to me. “John, it’s not going to be a baptism that will help you. When you believe right now. We’ll lead you into Christ,” I said. We went through everything that he needs to do. But his daughter was also talking to him. “Yeah, John,” she said. We just both started talking to him. “All you need to do is say ‘I’m a sinner’ and say that ‘I’m a sinner,’ to Jesus and He will help you. And He won’t forget you,” I said. It was like I took him through Roman’s Road just like a preacher they say. And he really believed then. It wasn’t a week later, they called and his wife said he had died. But I was glad that he had made up his mind on his own when he believed. He used to go to church all the time, but he just stayed outside. He would just joke around with others out there. Even when they were talking about something else. But then that’s how it is when somebody knows they’re going to die soon. That’s when a person believes. Just like when Jesus was hanging, He said to the one next to Him, “Just remember me. Soon we will not be here,” He said.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: “Today,” He told him.

segments.speaker: jerry-scott
segments.text: ᏙᏳᏛ ᏣᎪᏎᎴᎧ Ꮭ--ᎨᏍᏗ’Ꭱ ᏱᎦᏬ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏝᎧ?
segments.transliteration: doyudv tsagoseleka tla--gesdi’e yigawo sgina tlaka?
segments.translation: Really. He told him. That one hadn’t been baptized, right?

segments.speaker: jerry-scott
segments.text: ᎠᏩᏅ,Ꮫ ᎨᎲ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ ... Ꮭ--Ꮭ ᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ ᏗᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᏗᎪᏪᎵ,
segments.transliteration: awanv,dv gehv tla yawanv,ta ... tla--tla sgi iga ditsigataha, digoweli,
segments.translation: As far as I know. I don’t really know. I don’t really know that much about the Bible.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Uh uh.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏣᎳᎩ, ᏥᏄᏍᏗᏓ,Ꮓ ... ‘Ꮩ ᏓᎦᎵ,ᏍᏔᏂ, ᏍᏕᎵᏍᎪ ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ,?
segments.transliteration: tsalagi, tsinusdida,no ... ‘do dagali,stani, sdelisgo tsalagi, gawonihisdi,?
segments.translation: The way Cherokee is today. What do you two think is going to happen to the Cherokee language?

segments.speaker: jerry-scott
segments.text: ᎢᎦᏓ,Ꮫ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬ ᎨᎲ ᎠᏆ,Ꮫ.ᎦᏅᏭ ᎠᏲᏛ ᏦᏤᎯ, “‘Ꮲ ᏫᏂ,ᏓᎦᎵ,ᏍᏔᏂ, ᏝᏃ ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ, ᏱᎨᎮᏍᏗ,” ᎠᎾᏗᎰ ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎢ ᎮᎾ, ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎤᏓᏝ,Ꭼ ᏣᏅ,Ꮤ, ᎣᏏ ᎢᎦᏅᎧ ᎠᎾᏝᏂᎬᏁ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ Ᏺ’Ꮩ Ꮭ ᎠᏬᎯᏳ Ꮭ ᏱᏄᎵ,ᏍᏙᏗ ᏣᎳᎩ ᎠᏯ ᎨᎲ *I mean* ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᎲ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂ, Ꭹ.Ꮆ ᎮᎾ, ᏣᏝᏂᎬᏁᎰ ... ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎪ ᎢᎦ ᎮᎾ, Ꮭ ᎮᎾ, ᎬᎵ,ᏒᎾ ᏱᎨᎵ ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎠᏯ ᎨᏒ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ, ᎠᏎᏅᎧ ᏳᎵ,ᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᎲ ᏓᎦᎵ,ᏍᏔᏂ, ᎠᏎ
segments.transliteration: igada,dv naniwesgv gehv aqua,dv.ganvwu ayodv tsotsehi, “‘tlv wini,dagali,stani, tlano tsalagi, aniwonisgi, yigehesdi,” anadiho asesgini hii hena, tsalagi, udatla,gv tsanv,ta, osi iganvka anatlanigvne danadeyohvsgv yo’do tla awohiyu tla yinuli,sdodi tsalagi aya gehv *I mean* gawonihisdi gehv tla yawanv,ta asesgini, gi.lo hena, tsatlanigvneho ... dadeyohvsgo iga hena, tla hena, gvli,svna yigeli tsalagi, aya gesv tla yawanv,ta, asenvka yuli,sdodi gehv dagali,stani, ase
segments.translation: Some people say, that I have heard, just us living now. It’s going to disappear. They are not going to be speaking anymore, they say. But now the Cherokee Nation people they are really trying to teach the language. Me, I don’t believe it’s going to disappear. I mean, the speaker, I don’t know but somebody that’s willing to teach the language. I don’t think it will die. I don’t know. But whatever is supposed to happen, is going to happen.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏂᎯᎾ ‘Ꮩ ᎮᎵ? ‘Ꮩ ᏓᎦᎵ,ᏍᏔᏂ, ᎮᎵ ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ?
segments.transliteration: nihina ‘do heli? ‘do dagali,stani, heli tsalagi, gawonihisdi?
segments.translation: What about you? What do you think is going to happen to the Cherokee language?

segments.speaker: mary-scott
segments.text: Uh...‘ᏢᏛ ᏫᏛᎵ,ᏒᏂ ᎨᎵᏍᎪᎢ Ꮭ ᎮᎾ, ᎣᏍᏓ ᏯᏂᏬᏂᏍᎪ ᎠᎾ,ᏕᎶ,ᏆᎠ ᎣᏂ, ... ᎨᎵᏍᎪᎢ ᎠᏯ, ᎨᎲ ᏝᏃ ᎣᏍᏓ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᎮᏍᏗ
segments.transliteration: Uh...‘tlvdv widvli,svni gelisgoi tla hena, osda yaniwonisgo ana,delo,quaa oni, ... gelisgoi aya, gehv tlano osda gawonisgi yigehesdi
segments.translation: I think it’s going to disappear. Because the ones that are learning are not speaking well enough. That’s what I think. There won’t be any good speakers.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎠᏯ ᏥᏂᏬᏂ ᏳᏍᏗ? ᏍᎩ’ᎡᏲ ᎮᎵ--ᏛᎵ,ᏍᏆᏗ, ᎮᎵ? ᎠᏯᏛ ᏍᏊ ᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᎵᎰ
segments.transliteration: aya tsiniwoni yusdi? sgi’eyo heli--dvli,squadi, heli? ayadv squu sgi nigeliho
segments.translation: You mean the way you and I talk? You mean that is going to end? I think the same, too.

segments.speaker: mary-scott
segments.text: Ꮭ Ꭹ.Ꮆ--Ꮭ Ꭹ.ᎶᏃ ᏱᏓᏁᏱᎲᎦ ᏃᏊ Ꮭ ᏯᏂᎦ,ᏔᎭ, ᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏥᏪᎲ ᏂᎦᏓ ᎠᏂᏧᏣ, ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᏚᏂᏴᏂᎲ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ “Ꮥ-ᏕᏤᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ, ᎨᎯᏲᎮᎸ,” ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎸ ᎠᏂᏧᏣ ᏧᎾ,ᏓᎵᏏ,...ᏧᎾ,ᏓᎵᏏ, ᏧᏂᎧᎭ, ᏗᏂᏲᏟ, ᏝᏛ Ꭹ.Ꮆ ᏱᏛᏕᏲᎲᎦ ᎠᏂᏲᏁᎦᏭᏛ ᏂᎦᏗ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᎨᎲ ᎠᏂᎨᏯ ᏥᏚᏂᎧᎭ ᎾᏁᎲ ᏍᏊ ᎠᏂᎨᏯ ᏂᎦᏓ ᎠᏎᏅ Ꮭ ᏱᏓᏁᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᏍᎩ ᎮᎾ, ᎨᎲ ᏍᏊ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏯᏕᎶᏆ ᎠᏲᏟ
segments.transliteration: tla gi.lo--tla gi.lono yidaneyihvga noquu tla yaniga,taha, sgi nigatsiwehv nigada anitsutsa, anitsalagi duniyvnihv tsunigayvlige “de-detseyohvsgesdi anitsalagi, gehiyohelv,” gatsiyohelv anitsutsa tsuna,dalisi,...tsuna,dalisi, tsunikaha, diniyotli, tladv gi.lo yidvdeyohvga aniyonegawudv nigadi tsunigayvlige anitsalagi aniwonisgi gehv anigeya tsidunikaha nanehv squu anigeya nigada asenv tla yidaneyohvsga sgi hena, gehv squu osda yadeloqua ayotli
segments.translation: There’s no one to teach now, they don’t know how. They picked it up from their grandparents. That’s what I tell the boys, “Teach them Cherokee all the time,” their grandkids that they have. Nobody taught them. All they talk is English. And all the parents are Cherokee speakers. Even the wives they have, they’re speakers, but they’re not teaching the kids. That’s the only way a child is going to learn.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yeah, that’s right. What’d you say?

segments.speaker: jerry-scott
segments.text: Ꮎ’Ꭱ Ꭺ.Ꭿ,Ꮣ ᏙᏧᎾ,Ꮫ.Ꮢ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ, ᏙᎩᏂᎧᎲ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏍᏊ ᎾᎥ ᏄᎾ,ᏓᎸ ᏍᏊ ᏂᎦᏓ, ᎠᏂ’ᎯᎸᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ Ꮭ ᏳᎾ,ᏛᎸᎮ *church* ᎤᏁᏅᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᎠᎾᎵ,ᏣᏙᎲᏍᎩ,Ꮽ ᏙᏥᏯᏁᎲ--ᏙᏥᏯᏂᎲ ᎠᎾᎵ,ᏣᏙᏂᎲ ᏯᏂᎷᎦ *yard*ᎢᏭ ᎣᎩᏍᏆᎸᎡᎲ ᎨᎲ ... ᏍᎩᎾ Lawrence ᏥᎨᎲ ᏄᏪᏒ “Uh...Ꮭ Ꮩ’ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏳᏰᎵ,Ꮧ ᏯᎾ,ᏕᏠ,Ꮖ ᎠᏣᎳᎩ, ᎨᏍᏗ, ᎮᎾ, ... ‘Ꮲ ᏗᏓᎾᏅ ᏩᏂᎷᏨ ᎨᏍᏗ, ᎮᎾ, ᎠᏣᎳᎩ ᏱᏗᏯᎡᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᏁᎦ ᏗᏯᎡᏍᏗ,” ᏣᏗ ᏦᎪᏎᎲᏪ
segments.transliteration: na’e go.hi,da dotsuna,dv.sv diniyotli, doginikahv anisoi squu nav nuna,dalv squu nigada, ani’hilvsgi naniv diniyotli tla yuna,dvlvhe *church* unenvsdi na anali,tsadohvsgi,wu dotsiyanehv--dotsiyanihv anali,tsadonihv yaniluga *yard*iwu ogisqualvehv gehv ... sgina Lawrence tsigehv nuwesv “Uh...tla do’ osda yuyeli,di yana,detlo,qua atsalagi, gesdi, hena, ... ‘tlv didananv wanilutsv gesdi, hena, atsalagi yidiyaesdi ayonega diyaesdi,” tsadi tsogosehvwe
segments.translation: Like our kids, the way they grew up. They grew up with a bunch of other kids in the neighborhood. There were a whole bunch of them. But they never wanted to go to church. So we went and got the preachers to come have church in the yard. But that Lawrence said, “It is no use for the kids to learn Cherokee. When they get to the store somewhere they will not see a Cherokee, they will see white people,” he would tell us.

segments.speaker: mary-scott
segments.text: ᏍᎩᏛ ᏄᏪᏒ ᏦᏍᏓᏓᎸ ᏥᏲᎮᎸ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ ᏣᎳᎩ, ᏂᎦᏓ, “Ꮭ--ᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏅ,ᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᎮᏍᏗ ᏣᎳᎩ ᏂᎨᎵᏍᎪ,” ᏣᏬᎮᎸ ᏦᏍᏓᏓᎸ ᏌᏊ ᏂᎦᏓ’Ꭱ ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎣᏥᏬᏂᏍᎩ,
segments.transliteration: sgidv nuwesv tsosdadalv tsiyohelv dideyodi diniyotli tsalagi, nigada, “tla--gesdi tsunv,dodi yigehesdi tsalagi nigelisgo,” tsawohelv tsosdadalv saquu nigada’e tsalagi, otsiwonisgi,
segments.translation: That’s what I tell my sister. “You need to teach Cherokee to the kids,” I told her. “I don’t think they need to learn. They won’t use it,” she told me. One of my sisters said, “All of us are Cherokee speakers.”

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎾᎿᎭ...ᏗᎦᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁ,Ꮧ, ᎤᎾᎵ,ᏍᏕᎵ;ᏙᏗ, ᎤᏂᏩᏛ.Ꮧ, ‘Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏗ,--‘Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᏍᏗᎪᏩ,ᏘᎰ ᎨᎲ ‘ᏢᏴ ᏥᎨᏎᏍᏗ,? Greenleaf-Ꭷ ᏥᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗᏍ?
segments.transliteration: nahnaha...digalvwi,sdane,di, unali,sdeli;dodi, uniwadv.di, ‘do usdi,--‘do usdesdi, sdigowa,tiho gehv ‘tlvyv tsigesesdi,? Greenleaf-ka tsinusdesdis?
segments.translation: What about work for the children to depend on? What do y’all think it’s going to be like? A long time from now, as you two see it. Is Greenleaf still going to be there?

segments.speaker: jerry-scott
segments.text: ᏄᏍᏕᏗᏭᏛ’Ᏺ ᎥᎾ ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂ, ... ᎨᏍᏗ’Ꭱ’Ᏺ Ꭹ.Ꮆ ᏳᏚᎵᎭ, ᏧᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁ,ᏗᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂ, ᎠᏂᎧᎵᏃ Ꭺ.Ꭿ ᏥᎩ ᎥᎾ ... ᏛᎵ,ᏒᏂᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁ,Ꮧ, ... Ꮭ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂ, Ꮵ,ᏈᏯ--Ꮵ,ᏈᏯ *borders* ᏓᏂ--ᏓᏂᏍᏚᎢᏎᎲ ᎠᏂᏴᏟᎲ ᏄᎾ,ᏓᎴ ᏍᎩ’Ꭱ ᏍᏊ ᏱᎦᏪᏍᏗ ᎨᎲ Lawrence ᏥᎨᎲ “ᎪᏪᎳ ᎮᎾ, ᏍᏊ,” ᎤᏛᏅ “ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏃᎯᏳ,Ꮧ ᎠᏂᏴᏫ, ... ᎠᏂᏐᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘᏂ, ᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒ ᏛᏂᏒᏃᏂ ᎠᎵ,ᏍᏓᏴ,Ꮧ,” ᎠᏗᏍᎨ ᎨᎲ Lawrence ᏳᎵ,ᏣᏙᏅ ᎠᏎᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ ᎠᏎ ‘Ꮲ ᎠᏎ Ꮩ’ ᏍᎩᎾ ... Ꮭ ᎮᎾ,...ᏛᎵ,ᏒᏂᏛ ᏍᎩ ᎮᎾ, ᏳᏍᏗ, ᏗᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ, ᏥᎩ, *college*ᎢᏭ *y’know* Ꮭ’Ꭱ ᏍᏊ ᏱᏚᏯᏂᎰ ᏚᏂᎸᏫ,ᏍᏁ,Ꮧ, ᎢᎦᏓ, ᏁᎳᎦᏭ *college* ᏓᏂᏍᏆᏛ ᏱᎩ, ᏏᏭᏃ Ꮟ ᎠᏂᏉᎴᏏᏙᎰᏃ ᏭᎪᏛ ᎮᎾ, ᎠᏎ ᏗᎦᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁ,Ꮧ, ᏳᏚᎵ ᎾᎮᎾ ᎠᏕᎶ,ᏆᏍᏗ, ᎮᎾ, *Vo-Tech* ᏴᏛ Ꮎ ᏥᎩ, Ꮎ ... *refrigerator* Ꮎ *A/C* ᎣᏍᏓ ᏗᏅᏁᎲ ᏣᏁᎯ, ᏍᎩᎾ ᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᎦ ᎮᎾ, ᎣᏍᏓ ᎠᏂᏩᏛ.ᏘᎰ ᏧᏂᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁ,Ꮧ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏅᏌ, ᏚᏃ--ᏚᏃᎰᏂ,Ꮧ ᏚᏃᏢᏒ, ᏍᎩᏳᏍᏗ, ... ᏌᏊ ᏥᏲᎵᎦ, ᎠᏴᏫᏯ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏳᏍᏗ, ᏍᎩᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᏁᏙᎰ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏯᏥᏅᏏ, ... ᎠᏎᎦᎪ ᎮᎾ, ᏍᏊ Ꮭ ᎠᏬᎯᏳ ᏱᎨ.Ꮃ ᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏛ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ, ᏍᏊᏛᎲ
segments.transliteration: nusdediwudv’yo vna asesgini, ... gesdi’e’yo gi.lo yuduliha, tsulvwi,sdane,dino na anisquani, anikalino go.hi tsigi vna ... dvli,svnidv digalvwi,sdane,di, ... tla osda yigi, asesgini, tsi,quiya--tsi,quiya *borders* dani--danisduisehv aniyvtlihv nuna,dale sgi’e squu yigawesdi gehv Lawrence tsigehv “gowela hena, squu,” udvnv “anisdaya unohiyu,di aniyvwi, ... anisoi, utsatini, dayunilosv dvnisvnoni ali,sdayv,di,” adisge gehv Lawrence yuli,tsadonv asenv gowela ase ‘tlv ase do’ sgina ... tla hena,...dvli,svnidv sgi hena, yusdi, dideloquasdi, tsigi, *college*iwu *y’know* tla’e squu yiduyaniho dunilvwi,sne,di, igada, nelagawu *college* danisquadv yigi, siwuno si aniquolesidohono wugodv hena, ase digalvwi,sdane,di, yuduli nahena adelo,quasdi, hena, *Vo-Tech* yvdv na tsigi, na ... *refrigerator* na *A/C* osda dinvnehv tsanehi, sgina yusdi, iga hena, osda aniwadv.tiho tsunilvwi,sdane,di ilvhiyu unvsa, duno--dunohoni,di dunotlvsv, sgiyusdi, ... saquu tsiyoliga, ayvwiya sgina yusdi, sgiyusdi, nadvneho nedoho sgina yatsinvsi, ... asegago hena, squu tla awohiyu yige.la sgi yinusdv tla yawanv,ta, squudvhv
segments.translation: It’s still going to be there. But nobody wants to work. There are only Hispanics working there now. There aren’t going to be any job opportunities because they’re opening the border for too many different people, that are coming in. That’s what Lawrence used to say, also, “That’s what the Bible says, ‘there will be a lot of different nationalities coming in, and they are going to eat up the food,’ Lawrence used to say when he preached. I guess it is written somewhere. Everything is going to run out. That’s why you need to go to college. But also there are no jobs for them, even when they finish college. They just hunt around but can’t find anything. But most of all, maybe you should learn a trade. Like at a votech. Like refrigerator or A/C repairmen training—they do find good jobs. Also, they have their own company. I know one Indian man. That’s what he does. Sometimes he gets sent and it’s unusual for a native to have a job like that. I don’t know…

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: How about you, what do you think it’ll be?

segments.speaker: mary-scott
segments.translation: What?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ‘Ꮲ--‘Ꮲ--‘ᏢᏴ ᏥᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ‘Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎮᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁ,Ꮧ, ᎠᏩᏛ.Ꮧ ᎨᏒ? ᏗᎪᎨ. ᎤᎵ,ᏒᏁᏍᏗ? ‘Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏗ, ᎮᎵᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ?
segments.transliteration: ‘tlv--‘tlv--‘tlvyv tsigesesdi, ‘do usdesdi, heli digalvwi,sdane,di, awadv.di gesv? digoge. uli,svnesdi? ‘do usdi, helisgo nihi?
segments.translation: What do you think it’ll be like finding a job in the future? Or will everything be gone, you think?

segments.speaker: mary-scott
segments.text: ᏍᎩᏛᎲ ᎨᎵᏍᎪ ᏓᏳᎾᎵ,Ꮷ ᏃᏭ ᏧᏂᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁ,Ꮧ, ᎯᎾ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ, ᏣᎾ--ᏣᎾᏓᏖᏍᏓᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂ ᏥᎩ, ᏥᏈᏍᏙᏒ ᏳᏂᎷᏣᏭᏂ ᎠᎾᎴᏂᎰ ᏧᏂᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏍᎩᎮᎾ, ᏂᎦᏥᏪᎮᎰ ᎠᏂᏧᏣ “ᎮᏍᏗ, ᏗᏥᏲᏒᎢ Ꭹ.Ꮆ Ꭾ ᏄᏓᎴ ᏛᎩᏏ,” ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎰᎢᏅ ... ᏧᏂᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁ,Ꮧ, ᎤᎾ,ᏚᎵᎭ
segments.transliteration: sgidvhv gelisgo dayunali,tsu nowu tsunilvwi,sdane,di, hina anisoi, tsana--tsanadatesdadi anisquani tsigi, tsiquisdosv yunilutsawuni analeniho tsunilvwi,sdanedi sgihena, nigatsiweheho anitsutsa “hesdi, ditsiyosvi gi.lo he nudale dvgisi,” gatsiyohehoinv ... tsunilvwi,sdane,di, una,duliha
segments.translation: I think they’re not going to be able to find jobs because of the Hispanics. As soon as they get here, they start working. That’s what I tell my boys, “Don’t give up your job, somebody else is going to take it.”

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: They are paying them real low these Hispanics. Ain’t it?

segments.speaker: mary-scott
segments.translation: Yeah, that’s what they say.

segments.speaker: jerry-scott
segments.text: ᏍᎩᏛ Ꭺ.ᎯᎢᎦ ᏙᏣᏕᏍᎬ ᎾᎥ ᎣᎦᏓᎸ ᏒᎦ,Ꮤ, Auffet-Ꭲ ‘Ꮲ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ “ᎯᎳᎦ ᏕᏣᏈᏴᎡᎲ?” “*About $20 a box,*” ᏧᏛᏅᏛ ᎤᏔᎾ, ᏱᎩ.Ꮧ, *box ... “we’ll do it for less,”* ᎤᎾ,ᏛᏅ ᎾᎯᏳ ... ᎾᎯᏳ ᏚᏂᎾᏝᎥ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂ, (ᎤᏰᏥ,ᏍᎦ)
segments.transliteration: sgidv go.hiiga dotsadesgv nav ogadalv svga,ta, Auffet-i ‘tlv anisquani unilutsv “hilaga detsaquiyvehv?” “*About $20 a box,*” tsudvnvdv utana, yigi.di, *box ... “we’ll do it for less,”* una,dvnv nahiyu ... nahiyu duninatlav anisquani, (uyetsi,sga)
segments.translation: That’s right. We used to pick apples over at Auffets and then the Hispanics came. “How much do you pay them?” he said “Twenty dollars for a box, a big box.” “We’ll do it for less,” they said. That’s when they hired the Hispanics.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: They are hard workers, aren’t they?

segments.speaker: jerry-scott
segments.text: ᏧᏂᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎯ ‘Ᏺ ᏙᏳ, ᏚᏂᏩᏛ ᎮᎾ, ᏯᏛᏁ,Ꮧ ᏥᎩ, ... *remodel*Ꮽ ᏍᏊ ᏂᎦᏓ ᏗᎬᏁᎸ ᏗᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᏍᎩᏭ ᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎾᎡ ‘Ᏺ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎨᏍᏗ ᎮᎾ, ᎤᏂ,ᏢᏲᎴ ᏱᎩ ᏙᏳ
segments.transliteration: tsunilvwi,sdanehi ‘yo doyu, duniwadv hena, yadvne,di tsigi, ... *remodel*wu squu nigada digvnelv digalitsode sgiwu yusdi uninae ‘yo sgina gesdi hena, uni,tlvyole yigi doyu
segments.translation: Yeah, they are. They find them even just to remodel a house. They really got it, they are not lazy, really.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎠᏯᏛ ‘ᎸᏍᎩ ᏳᏒ ᏥᎨᎲ *four-wheeler* ᏥᏓᏃ--ᏅᎩ, ᏗᎦᏆᏘ, ᏥᏓᏃᎮᎰ ᎠᎩᏄᎸᎲᏍᎬᏛ Ꮎ *gas* ᎠᎩᏟ--ᎬᎩᏃᏍᎩᏍᎬ ᏍᎩᎮᎾ, ᏳᏍᏗ *shed* ᎠᏩᏚᎸᎲ ... ᏙᏳ, ᎤᏂᎷᏨ ᏂᎦᏓ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂ ᎨᎲ ᎩᎳᏭ,Ꮫ ᎤᎾᏁᏍᎨᎲ ᎠᏯᎮᎾ, ᏍᏊ ᏗᎩᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎸ Ꮎ *Greenleaf* Ꮳ.ᏗᎲ ‘ᏲᎡ *a $1.25* ᏥᎨᎲ
segments.transliteration: ayadv ‘lvsgi yusv tsigehv *four-wheeler* tsidano--nvgi, digaquati, tsidanoheho aginulvhvsgvdv na *gas* agitli--gvginosgisgv sgihena, yusdi *shed* awadulvhv ... doyu, unilutsv nigada anisquani gehv gilawu,dv unanesgehv ayahena, squu digilvwi,sdanelv na *Greenleaf* tsa.dihv ‘yoe *a $1.25* tsigehv
segments.translation: I had a hard time with my four-wheelers. I decided to build a shed, and that’s who came to build it, the Hispanics. It didn’t take them long to build it. I used to work at Greenleaf, too, it was $1.25 back then.

segments.speaker: jerry-scott
segments.translation: That’s what it was then.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: The Hispanics were already there then.

segments.speaker: jerry-scott
segments.text: .75Ꮫ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏣᏩᎴᏅᎲ ᎠᏯ, *’bout 2 weeks*ᎢᏴ .85 ᎨᎮᏍᏗᏃ ᏧᎾ,ᏛᏅ
segments.transliteration: .75dv tsigehv tsawalenvhv aya, *’bout 2 weeks*iyv .85 gehesdino tsuna,dvnv
segments.translation: It was 75 (cents) when I started working. And they told us in two weeks it will be 85 (cents).

segments.speaker: mary-scott
segments.text: ᏍᎩᎾ ᏦᎩᏁᏅᏒ ᏧᏂᎵᏦᏔᏂᏢ ᏏᏅᏗᏴ ᏔᎵ ᎴᏱᎦ, ᏂᎦᏓ,Ꮫ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏍᎩᎾ Ꮽ-ᏭᎵ,ᏍᏓᏁᎸ Ꭹ.Ꮆ *Cherokee Nation* ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ “ᎠᏂ-ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂ, ᏂᎦᏓ ᎨᎲ ᏧᏂᏴ,Ꮧ” ᏣᏬᎮᎸ “ᎠᏂᏴᏫᏯ ᏧᏂᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁ,Ꮧ,” ᎤᏛᏅ “ᎥᎥ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᏨᏛᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᏳᏛᏅ ᏝᏯᏩᏅᏔ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎨᎲ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏢ
segments.transliteration: sgina tsoginenvsv tsunilitsotanitlv sinvdiyv tali leyiga, nigada,dv anisquani tsigehv sgina wu-wuli,sdanelv gi.lo *Cherokee Nation* tsulvwisdanehv “ani-anisquani, nigada gehv tsuniyv,di” tsawohelv “aniyvwiya tsunilvwi,sdane,di,” udvnv “vv anisquanidv anatsvdvsgi tsidayudvnv tlayawanvta sgina gehv uninohetlv
segments.translation: We hired them for a month or two and sure enough all Hispanics showed up. There was someone at the house that was working with Cherokee Nation. “It’s all the Hispanics coming to get all of the natives’ jobs,” he told us. “Yeah, the Hispanics are taking over,” he said, I don’t know who it was.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yeah, that’s true, they are taking over.

segments.speaker: mary-scott
segments.translation: That’s what he said. They do it on a contract.

segments.speaker: jerry-scott
segments.text: ᏥᏈᏍᏗᏛᏅ ᏴᎩ, ᏓᏭᏖᏒ ᎨᏍᏗ ᏱᏚᏄᏖᏒ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏧᏁᏙᎸ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ, TᎦ ᏓᏭᏖᏒ ᎣᏍᏓ, ᎢᎦ ᏓᏭᏖᏒ
segments.transliteration: tsiquisdidvnv yvgi, dawutesv gesdi yidunutesv sgina tsunedolv tla yawanv,ta, Tga dawutesv osda, iga dawutesv
segments.translation: I picked up a lot of nails when they left. They didn’t pick them up. I don’t know how many I picked up, but I picked up quite a few.

segments.speaker: mary-scott
segments.translation: And their boss wasn’t even there.

segments.speaker: jerry-scott
segments.text: Huh uh. “I’’m not gonna be here, this is the last time I’ll be here,” ᎤᏛᏅᏭ ᏧᏂᎩᏒ *contract* ᏗᎬᏁᎲ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏙᏳ, ᏍᎩᎾ,Ᏺ ᎣᏍᏓ, ᎮᎾ, ᏄᎾ,ᏛᏁᎸ ᏚᏂᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ, ᎨᎲ’Ᏺ *I mean...* ᎮᏍᏗ, ᏳᏂᎾᎴ (ᎤᏰᏥ,ᏍᎦ)

segments.translation: When I was working at Greenleaf, working with the Hispanics, they would ask if they could work overtime. When they worked overtime, the boss was expecting it because they had a lot of work. They really want to work, the Hispanics. But I guess it’s good, they’re that way.

segments.text: ᏍᎩᏭᏛ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎪᏩ,ᏘᎰ ᎠᏯ, ᏙᏳ ᎮᎾ, ᏛᎵ,ᏒᏂ ᎠᏁᎲ’Ᏺ ᏙᏳ, ᎠᎵ,ᏍᏓᏴ,Ꮧ, ᎦᏳ,Ꮃ,ᏛᎲ ᏱᏫᏣᏴᏟᏝ, ᎤᏅᏛ Ꮭ ᏱᏗᎦᏁᎯ, ᎦᏚ ᎴᏱᎦ, *walmart* ᏍᏊᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎥᏍᎩᎮᎾ, ᏍᏊ ᎤᎪᏗ ᎤᎾᎵ,ᏍᎦᎯᏗ, *walmart*Ꭲ ᏛᎵ,ᏒᏂ, ᎠᏁᎲ ᎠᎵ,ᏍᏓᏴ,Ꮧ, ᏛᏂᏑᎵ,ᎪᏣ ᏍᏊ ᎠᏗ--ᎠᎾ,Ꮧ ᏍᏊ *walmart* ᎢᎦᏓ, ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎨᎲ ᏝᏍᏊ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ, ᏙᏳ, ᏱᏂ,ᏓᎦᎵ,ᏍᏓᏔᏂ, *I mean...* ‘ᏢᎡ ...ᎠᏎ ᎮᎾ, ᏳᎵ,ᏍᏙᏗ, ‘Ᏺ “ᏙᏛᎪᏄᎶᏏ,” ᏣᏗ ᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᏎ’Ᏺ ᏳᎵ,ᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏯ ᎨᎲ Ꮭ ᎮᎾ, ᏱᏕᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏯ ᏗᎦᏁᎵ,Ꮧ ᎨᎲ ᎾᏛᎾ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅ ᏂᎨᎲᎾ ᎥᏍᎩᎮᎾ, “ᏕᏥᏍᏛᏗᏍᏔᏂ,” ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂ ᏴᎰᎧ ᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᎯᏳ,Ꮧ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏂᎪᏗ, ᏗᏂᏲᏟ, ᏣᏁᎯ, ᎾᎮᎾ, ᏍᎩᎮᎾ ᏗᎵᏒᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ, ᎨᏍᏗ ᎮᎾ, ᎣᏍᏓ, Ᏸ.ᎮᏍᏗ *social security* ᏥᎩ, ᏛᎵ,ᏒᏂ’ᎡᏪ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏥᏈᏯᏛ Ꮎ ᏓᎾ,ᏤᏩ ᎠᏕᎳ, ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏩᏒᏓᏂ, ᎠᏂᏯ ᏍᎩᏭ ᎢᎦ ᏱᏂᏥᏪ ᎨᎲ
segments.transliteration: sgiwudv iga tsigowa,tiho aya, doyu hena, dvli,svni anehv’yo doyu, ali,sdayv,di, gayu,la,dvhv yiwitsayvtlitla, unvdv tla yidiganehi, gadu leyiga, *walmart* squudv tsigi, vsgihena, squu ugodi unali,sgahidi, *walmart*i dvli,svni, anehv ali,sdayv,di, dvnisuli,gotsa squu adi--ana,di squu *walmart* igada, aninohesgv gehv tlasquu yawanv,ta, doyu, yini,dagali,sdatani, *I mean...* ‘tlve ...ase hena, yuli,sdodi, ‘yo “dodvgonulosi,” tsadi gowela, ase’yo yuli,sdodi, asesgini aya gehv tla hena, yidedohesdi aya diganeli,di gehv nadvna unohiyunv nigehvna vsgihena, “detsisdvdistani,” asesgini yvhoka sgi unohiyu,di yigi, unigodi, diniyotli, tsanehi, nahena, sgihena dilisvsdi diniyotli, gesdi hena, osda, ye.hesdi *social security* tsigi, dvli,svni’ewe sgina tsiquiyadv na dana,tsewa adela, nunigvwiyusv wasvdani, aniya sgiwu iga yinitsiwe gehv
segments.translation: This is about all I see; there is really going to be hard times. Today if you go into a store, like Walmart, there is no milk or bread. And also, people are depending on Walmart too much. They are going to run out of food, they say. They are going to quit Walmart, some people are saying. But I don’t really know. I mean, that is what is predicted in the Bible. But us Christians, we won’t be here. The ones that don’t believe, they are the ones that are going to be punished. It will be good if more children would believe, there are a lot of children here. We have to fight for the children because there will be nothing here for them. Even the social security is going to run out. They are wasting too much money the leaders that are in Washington. That’s all I can say.
